title.en: Should Students Take a Gap Year?
title.zh: 高中畢業後該不該先休息一年？

subtitle: 全民英檢中高級：討論高中畢業後空檔年的利弊
task: In some countries, many students take a "gap year" to work, travel, or volunteer before starting university. Write an essay of 150–180 words. In your essay, (1) discuss one advantage and one possible problem of taking a gap year, and (2) state whether you would recommend it to students in Taiwan, giving your reasons.
taskZh: 在一些國家，很多學生在上大學前會先休息一年（空檔年），去工作、旅行或當志工。請寫一篇 150–180 字的英文文章：(1) 討論空檔年的一個優點和一個可能的問題，(2) 說明你是否會推薦台灣的學生這麼做，並提出理由。
focus: 內容：優點、問題、自己的立場與理由都要寫到，論點具體切題
組織：引言、正反討論、結論層次分明，段落間轉折自然
文法：句型多樣（讓步子句、分詞構句、假設語氣）且正確
用字：字彙豐富精確，避免重複，拼字與標點正確

en: For most students in Taiwan, going straight from high school to university is simply what is expected. However, a growing number of young people are considering a gap year instead.

The main advantage of a gap year is that it gives students time to discover what they truly want. Having spent months working in a café or volunteering abroad, a student is more likely to choose a major based on real experience rather than on test scores alone. On the other hand, a gap year can easily become a wasted year. Without clear goals, some students simply stay at home and lose the habit of studying, which makes returning to school even harder.

Overall, I would recommend a gap year, but only to students who plan it carefully. If students set specific goals, such as saving money, improving a language, or trying out a possible career, the year can be one of the most valuable of their lives. Otherwise, it is wiser to start university right away.
zh: 對台灣大多數學生來說，高中畢業直接上大學是理所當然的事。然而，越來越多年輕人開始考慮先休息一年。
空檔年的主要優點是讓學生有時間發掘自己真正想要的是什麼。在咖啡店工作或到國外當志工幾個月之後，學生比較可能根據真實經驗而不只是考試分數來選擇科系。另一方面，空檔年也很容易變成白白浪費的一年。沒有明確目標的話，有些學生只是待在家裡，失去讀書的習慣，回到學校反而更困難。
整體來說，我會推薦空檔年，但只推薦給仔細規劃的學生。如果學生設定具體的目標，例如存錢、加強一種語言，或試試看某個可能的職業，這一年就可能成為他們人生中最有價值的時光之一。否則，還是直接上大學比較明智。

patterns.pattern: The main advantage of … is that …
patterns.example: The main advantage of a gap year is that it gives students time to discover what they truly want.

patterns.zh: 完成式分詞構句：表示先發生的事
patterns.example: Having spent months working in a café or volunteering abroad, a student is more likely to choose a major based on real experience rather than on test scores alone.

patterns.pattern: On the other hand, … can easily become …
patterns.example: On the other hand, a gap year can easily become a wasted year.

patterns.pattern: Overall, I would recommend …, but only to …
patterns.zh: 結論：有條件地表達立場
patterns.example: Overall, I would recommend a gap year, but only to students who plan it carefully.
